newsitem.title: USA: WANG JOINS LUCENT IN NAVY CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: WANG JOINS LUCENT IN NAVY CONTRACT.

text.p: Wang Laboratories Inc said Thursday that its Government Services unit has been selected by the U.S. Navy as part of the Lucent Technologies Inc team, which will provide technical services for the Voice, Video and Data contract valued at $2.9 billion over 10 years.
Lucent Technologies is the primary contractor for this fixed-price indefinite-delivery, indefinite-quantity contract to upgrade Naval communications infrastructure.

Wang said it will provide integrated network management services, integrated voice, video and data network design and implementation, enterprise level consulting, help desk services, desktop services, multi-vendor maintenance, client/ server operation and management, outsourcing, and training.
Wang is a network and desktop integration and services company, with annual revenues of about $1.3 billion.
